決まったことを待っています…
やることを待っています…
オンボーディングを試作する

answers.q1: Mostly grounded, and I can tell. Each メモ line has a name, a timestamp, and a '出所 >' (source) link, and the transcript panel on the right shows the same wording at the same time (10:42 Ken macOS を先に出します). That pairing reads as extracted-from-speech, not invented. The one exception is the bold 'Ken Windows は次の周で追います。' line at the very top under the meeting title — it has no timestamp or 出所 link, so I'm less sure if that's a live quote, a pinned highlight, or something else.
answers.q2: I would click the '出所 >' link next to a メモ item (e.g. next to 'macOS を先に出します') — it's labeled explicitly as source and sits right on the item, so it's the obvious first click. Failing that, I'd glance at the 文字起こし transcript panel on the right, since its timestamps line up with the メモ entries.
answers.q3: Yes for the メモ items — each shows a speaker name and a clock time (Ken・10:42, Sarah・14:21), duplicated once as the inline label and once below. For the top 'Windows は次の周で追います。' line, only the speaker (Ken) is shown, no timestamp, so that one is partially unclear.
answers.q4: I would click the pencil icon next to a メモ item's text (visible next to both 'macOS を先に出します' and 'オンボーディングを試作する'). There's also a chevron next to it that looks like it expands/collapses the entry, maybe to more edit options. I do not see any obvious way to correct the top 'Windows は次の周で追います。' line, or the transcript lines on the right — no edit icon appears there.
answers.q5: Moderately uneasy right now, but mostly because the meeting just started (00:02) rather than because I distrust the content. 決まったこと and やること both show a waiting placeholder with nothing filled in, so there's not much substance to share yet, and I'd worry a recipient might misread the placeholder text as a bug rather than 'nothing decided so far.' The two メモ items that do exist look trustworthy enough to forward given the source links and attribution.

weaknesses.what: 決まったこと and やること show a passive waiting placeholder ('を待っています…') with no distinct empty-state styling, which could read as a stuck or broken state to a first-time viewer rather than 'nothing decided yet'.
weaknesses.fix: Use a clearly-labeled empty state (e.g. a muted icon plus 'まだありません') that visually differs from a loading/spinner state.

weaknesses.what: The bold 'Ken Windows は次の周で追います。' line under the meeting title has no timestamp or 出所 link like the メモ items below it, so it's unclear whether it's a live extracted quote, a pinned highlight, or a heading.
weaknesses.fix: Give it the same timestamp + 出所 link treatment as the メモ entries so its provenance is legible the same way.

weaknesses.what: The pencil and chevron icons on メモ items are small and low-contrast gray, easy to miss on a first pass despite being the only visible edit affordance.
weaknesses.fix: Increase icon contrast or add a hover/tooltip cue so the edit action is noticed without deliberate searching.
